EO Data DB

AMSU

Radio

The Advanced Microwave Sounding Unit-A (AMSU-A) is a 15-channel microwave sounder designed primarily to obtain temperature profiles in the upper atmosphere.

Data Sources:

Platforms:

NOAA

Themes:

Atmosphere

AVHRR

VNIR, SWIR

The Advanced Very High Resolution Radiometer (AVHRR) provides four- to six-band multispectral data from the NOAA polar-orbiting satellite series.

Data Sources:

Platforms:

NOAA

Themes:

Land, Atmosphere, Marine

Aquarius

Radio

Its mission was to measure global sea surface salinity to better predict future climate conditions.

Data Sources:

Platforms:

SAC-D

Themes:

Marine

ECOSTRESS

VNIR, SWIR

The ECOsystem Spaceborne Thermal Radiometer Experiment on Space Station (ECOSTRESS) mission measures the temperature of plants to better understand how much water plants need and how they respond to stress.

Data Sources:

Platforms:

ISS

Themes:

Land

EarthCARE

Radar, LIDAR, SWIR, VNIR

ESA's cloud and aerosol mission. With four instruments, the Earth Cloud Aerosol and Radiation Explorer (EarthCARE) satellite mission shall shed light on the role that clouds and aerosols play in regulating Earth’s climate.

Data Sources:

Platforms:

EarthCare

Themes:

Atmosphere

ASTER

VNIR, SWIR

The Advanced Spaceborne Thermal Emission and Reflection Radiometer (ASTER) is a Japanese remote sensing instrument onboard the Terra satellite.

Data Sources:

Platforms:

Terra

Themes:

Land, Atmosphere

AVNIR-2

VNIR

The Advanced Visible and Near-Infrared Radiometer-2 (AVNIR-2) was a four band (visible and near-infrared) radiometer with a resolution of 10 m

VNIR, SWIR

It's an optical imaging satellite collaboratively operated by the Chinese CRESDA and Brazilian INPE. It will be used to monitor water resources, agriculture, urban growth, and land use.
